builder.exampleOtherHost: Every search must use the same service address ({{host}}).
builder.requestLine: The request GHOST will make ({{input}} is the searched value; you can edit this directly):
builder.lineNoInput: The request doesn't contain {{input}}, so every search would ask for the same thing.
builder.tryPlaceholder: A real value to test with, e.g. {{example}}
builder.tryNeedsKey: This service needs a key: add one under "Connecting" first.
builder.tryOk: It worked (HTTP {{status}}). Now pick what to keep from the response.
builder.tryNotFound: The service found nothing for this value. Try a value that will have results so you can pick fields.
builder.pickHelp: Click each value investigators should see. Click "whole list" next to a list of plain values to keep all of them.
builder.pickHint: Click to use this value as a result field
builder.responseTrimmed: Long lists are shortened here; searches still read the full response.
builder.listQuestion: That value is inside a list. How should it be shown?
builder.listPerItem: Each item in "{{list}}" is a separate result
builder.listCollected: Show one result, collecting this value from every item
builder.pickOutsideList: Pick values inside "{{list}}", the list each result comes from, or remove the fields to start over.
builder.noFields: Nothing picked yet: click values in the response.
builder.rootPerItem: Each item of "{{list}}" becomes one result.
builder.mergeDuplicatesHelp: Results that come out the same are shown once, with how often they occurred (for example ×27). Values collected from every item are always counted.
builder.rootWhole: The whole response is one result.
builder.addAs: Can be added to a person as
builder.keepKey: Keep the key I tested with as the tool's shared key
builder.shareNote: Want others to use it too? Download the file and propose it for the community folder on GitHub.
builder.buildNewLink: Not in the list? Build a new integration
builder.copyInBuilder: Use as a starting point in the builder
builder.installedNextStep: Installed {{name}}. Add a tool that uses it on the Tools page.
builder.authUrlHelp: For services that take the key inside the address itself, such as /api/your-key/lookup. Put {{keyMark}} where the key goes; GHOST fills in the stored key and keeps it out of the file and the logs.
builder.exampleKeyMarked: Your test key was found in the example and replaced with {{keyMark}}.
builder.keyPlaceholderMissing: Mark where the API key goes by putting {{keyMark}} in the request below.
builder.keyPlaceholderHint: Put {{keyMark}} where the API key goes.
builder.needKeyPlaceholder: Every search needs {{keyMark}} where the key goes.
builder.inputCustomTypes: Search button on these person entries
builder.inputCustomTypesHint: Entries of these OSINT data types get a search button for it. With none ticked, it searches typed-in values only.
builder.inputNoneHelp: Sends no value, for things like account balance or service status. It runs from the tool on the Tools page, and checks the connection when the key is tested.
builder.keepRecordsHelp: Each result also keeps everything the service returned for it, including fields you did not pick and fields only some results have. Investigators can save a record on a person and add values from it later.
builder.recordEachItem: Each item in "{{list}}" is one record.
builder.recordWholeResponse: The whole response is one record.
builder.noFieldsRecords: No fields picked: results show their full records only. Pick fields to show values and add them as OSINT data directly.

scratchpad.title: Scratchpad
scratchpad.composerPlaceholder: Paste or type… Markdown works. Ctrl+Enter to add
scratchpad.emptyHelp: Paste text below, or select text anywhere in GHOST and click “Add to scratchpad”. Use - [ ] for tick boxes.

todos.title: To-dos · {{project}}
todos.none: No open to-dos in this project.

settings.title: Scratchpad settings
settings.showTodosHelp: The active project's open to-dos, at the top of the pad.
settings.selectionButtonHelp: A small button appears when you select text anywhere in GHOST.
settings.positionHelp: Pick a corner. You can also drag the header to move it and the bottom-right edge to resize.
settings.opacityHelp: Fully visible while your mouse is over it or you're typing.
settings.shortcutCapture: add selected text (or jump to the input)
settings.privacyNote: Your notes are private to you, follow you across projects and devices, and aren't shared with anyone. To hide the scratchpad completely, go to Settings → General.

security.twoFactorDescription: After your password, GHOST also asks for a code from an authenticator app or for a passkey. Someone who learns your password still cannot sign in.
security.removeLastWarning: This is your last two-step method. Removing it turns two-step verification off and deletes your recovery codes.

totp.title: Authenticator app
totp.description: Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy, 1Password and other apps that show 6-digit codes.
totp.step1: Open your authenticator app and add an account.
totp.step2: Scan this QR code, or type the key below.
totp.step3: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
totp.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
totp.manualEntry: Can't scan it? Enter this key:
totp.removeKeepsPasskeys: You can still sign in with your passkeys.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.description: Confirm sign-in with your fingerprint, face, device PIN or a security key.
passkeys.addIntro: Give it a name so you can tell your passkeys apart. Your browser then asks where to save it.
passkeys.unsupportedBrowser: This browser does not support passkeys.
passkeys.otherAddress: Passkeys can be added when GHOST is opened at: {{origins}}
passkeys.notConfigured: Passkeys need GHOST to run on HTTPS with a domain name (or on localhost). Your administrator sets the address in FRONTEND_URL.

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.description: If you lose your phone or passkey, sign in with one of these. Each code works once.
recovery.dialogIntro: If you lose access to your authenticator app or passkey, you can sign in with one of these codes. Each works once. Keep them somewhere safe, like a password manager.
recovery.dialogWarning: You will not see these codes again.
recovery.fileHeader: GHOST recovery codes for {{username}}, created {{date}}. Each code works once.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.description: For the MCP server and scripts. A token acts as you, with your role and project access, and skips two-step verification, so keep it secret. Revoke it here when it is no longer needed.
tokens.newWarning: You will not see this token again. If you lose it, revoke it and create a new one.
tokens.mcpHint: For the MCP server, set GHOST_API_TOKEN to this value.

policy.title: Server policy
policy.requireLabel: Require two-step verification for every user
policy.requireDescription: Applies to sign-ins with a GHOST password: users without two-step verification are asked to set it up the next time they sign in, before they can use GHOST. Single sign-on users get two-step verification from the identity provider instead.
policy.ssoOnly: Everyone signs in with single sign-on (password sign-in is turned off), so two-step verification is set up and enforced at your identity provider.

gate.title: Set up two-step verification
gate.description: Your administrator requires two-step verification. Add an authenticator app or a passkey to continue.

errors.codeInvalid: That code is not valid. Check the time on your device and try again.
errors.signInExpired: Sign-in expired. Enter your password again.
errors.requiredByPolicy: Two-step verification is required on this server. Add another method before removing this one.
errors.enableOwnFirst: Set up two-step verification for your own account first.
errors.passkeyOrigin: Passkeys are not available at this address.
errors.passkeyExpired: The passkey request expired. Try again.
errors.passkeyInvalid: The passkey could not be verified.
errors.passkeyNone: None of your passkeys works at this address.
errors.setupExpired: Setup expired. Close this and start again.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.reauthRequired: For your security, sign in again with single sign-on first, then create the token.

security.ssoTwoFactor: You sign in with single sign-on, so two-step verification is handled by your identity provider.

records.title: Saved records
records.help: Results from integrated tools, kept exactly as the service returned them. Open a record to see every field; any value in it can be added to the OSINT data.
records.empty: No saved records. In a tool search, tick "Keep full record" on a result to save it here.
records.pickHint: Use + next to a value to add it to the OSINT data.
records.addedExisting: {{value}} was already in the OSINT data; this record is now one of its sources.

reasons.rate_limited: the geocoding provider is limiting requests, try again in a minute
reasons.timeout: the geocoding provider didn't answer in time
reasons.service_error: the geocoding provider returned an error
reasons.empty: there is no address to look up
